title: From detections to coherent cell lineages.
summary: A microscopy-tracking project spanning detection, temporal association, division modeling, graph evaluation, and fidelity audits. The public explorer makes graph decisions inspectable on authored synthetic data.
scope: The core review checks archive integrity and the evidence utility self-tests. Optional Node checks execute the public graph engine and interface. Full synthetic microscopy regeneration remains available through the existing pinned Python environment.
private_boundary: Microscopy volumes, competition-derived graphs, private model weights, exact fusion recipes, large intermediate tensors, and operational checkpoints are not added by this release.

cards.title: Solve association as a constrained graph problem.
cards.decision: Expose candidate links, lineage structure, and division behavior instead of hiding decisions behind a single score.
cards.boundary: The explorer uses synthetic microscopy, not withheld experimental volumes.

cards.title: Screen features without inflating evidence.
cards.decision: Keep feature candidates, measurements, and recorded selection outcomes linked to inspectable research reports.
cards.boundary: A large candidate count alone is not evidence of improved tracking.

cards.title: Preserve graph identity during optimization.
cards.decision: Audit selected links and graph fidelity so runtime changes can be separated from altered detections or coordinates.
cards.boundary: The reported speedup applies to motion linking, not the complete microscopy pipeline.

cards.title: Keep external transfer failures visible.
cards.decision: Retain the stronger system when a locally attractive candidate fails to transfer to external evaluation.
cards.boundary: Saved historical receipts are not a freshly run external benchmark.
